audit.whatIsWrong: content spikes[1].text names Xerath's ult "Rite of the Ancients" — the kit's real name is Rite of the Arcane.
audit.why: enemyAbilities.R is explicitly "Rite of the Arcane"; the fabricated name would mislead a reader searching in-game.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text fixed to Rite of the Arcane (ult).

audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 matches a 51.44% Xerath win rate over 8120 games.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0-2].side all read "Skill" but content win[0-2] and packet.levelChart[0-2] both say "Xerath" for those rows.
audit.why: Xerath's Q/W out-range everything Thresh has until The Box and boots arrive at 4-5, matching the content whys already on file.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side, phases[1].side, phases[2].side -> Xerath, whys and ratings rewritten to match; win[0-2] already correct, left alone.

edits.before: Rite of the Ancients (ult) rains multiple long-range shots — great for sniping a hooked target, but he's rooted while channeling, so a Flay or flank hook during his ult punishes him hard.
edits.after: Rite of the Arcane (ult) rains multiple long-range shots — great for sniping a hooked target, but he's rooted while channeling, so a Flay or flank hook during his ult punishes him hard.

edits.before: Auto-chip with the passive's armor souls pending — the scythe trades start the collection.
edits.after: Xerath's Q-W out-range every tool you have at level 1, so he pokes with no counterplay.

edits.before: Hook online: the lane plays behind minions or meets the sentence.
edits.after: His sustained Q poke chunks you before Flay is available, so he keeps the trade lead.

edits.before: Full kit: hook-flay-lantern is the playbook and every brush is a courtroom.
edits.after: Full Q-W-E poke range lets him stun your engage step and hold the advantage.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and the artillery never converts. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your W Dark Passage answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Shocking Orb (E) is his only hard CC, 13-11s cooldown — dodge it and the artillery never converts. Read it before every duo step-up. - Arcanopulse (Q) resets every 9-5s and chunks fastest early. - Spend your R on swing moments only.

edits.before: Hook the gap, flay the landing, lantern the collapse — the full sentence pays the whole team.
edits.after: Sit at your 1075-range hook threat — outside his 750-range Q you still menace a step-up, and souls collected here cost nothing.

edits.before: Fishing predictably while the souls walk past — the collection IS the scaling; greed the hooks, not the chips.
edits.after: Don't burn Flay on stray poke — save it to punish his rooted R channel or the all-in once Shocking Orb is down.

notes: Chart rows 0-2 were self-contradictory (full said Skill, content and packet both said Xerath); fixed side/why/rating to Xerath, win[] left untouched since it was already correct. Fabricated ult name 'Rite of the Ancients' corrected to 'Rite of the Arcane' in spikes[1].text.
